subject: Post-demo: cost alignment & spike policy options
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@avararetail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: cost alignment & spike policy options

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can align on commercial guardrails before the pilot: 

Recap
- Baseline: you said ~8M tokens/month steady state with marketing spikes (preview campaigns) that can hit short bursts up to ~40M tokens/day (peak minutes).
- Desired unit economics: target $/1M tokens in the range you mentioned — $700–$1,100 depending on commitment and latency SLAs.
- Key ask: how we handle short spikes (minutes) vs sustained increases (hours/days), and what overage math looks like.

Questions / asks from our side
1) Can you confirm a 90-day sample of token counts by day (CSV attached as "avararetail-traffic-sample.csv"). That will let us size batching and caching benefits.
2) For budgeting, can you confirm the monthly budget range you’re comfortable committing to for the pilot (ballpark is fine)? You mentioned $7K–$10K/month earlier — want to make sure I captured that correctly.
3) Any regulatory/compliance constraints (EU data residency or specific retention) we should flag for the pilot?

Proposed next steps
- We’ll send a pricing estimate (attached PDF) that shows two options: a committed baseline with discounted unit price, and a flat pay-as-you-go with burst policy.
- If that looks good, we’ll draft a short pilot SOW and a DocuSign for the commitment path.
- Recommend a 30-minute follow-up next week to lock on the pilot numbers.

Attachments: pricing-estimate-avararetail-20260815.pdf, avararetail-traffic-sample.csv

Thanks — appreciate the thoughtful questions on cost sensitivity.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@avararetail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Retail Billing <billing@avararetail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost alignment & spike policy options

Thanks Rishi — nice recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Baseline confirmation: yes, 8M tokens/month is our expectation for months without campaigns.
- Spikes: the preview campaigns are bursty by design. Typical spike profile: 10–30 minute bursts, up to ~5–6x baseline for a short window; rare sustained day-long increases during category launches.
- Budget: for a pilot, we’re looking at $8k–$12k/month depending on the committed unit price and guarantees on latency.

Two specific asks: 
1) What’s Redwood’s standard short-burst policy? Is there a grace window (e.g., X mins) where we won’t be charged overage if it’s ephemeral?
2) If we do cross monthly quota, what’s the typical overage multiplier and how predictable will the charge be (we need to size our finance forecast).

If you can put options side-by-side (committed + discount vs PAYG with burst cushion + overage rate), that would be ideal. Happy to do the follow-up call Wednesday morning.

—Sam
Sam Turner
Director, Product — Avara Retail
sam.turner@avararetail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost alignment & spike policy options (internal proposal)

Internal — quick commercial proposal to make Rishi’s outbound tidy. Thoughts: 

1) Pilot commercial construct (recommended):
   - Committed baseline: 8M tokens/month for 3 months. Unit price: $900 / 1M tokens.
   - Soft-burst window: allow transient bursts up to 3x baseline for 15 minutes without charging overage (we count toward quota, but don’t bill an overage fee if traffic returns under the threshold). This reduces surprise billing for short previews.
   - Sustained > 24 hours above baseline: trigger automatic temporary quota increase (billing option A) or overage charge (billing option B). Default to temporary quota increase for the pilot, with a one-time notification and optional short-term top-up.
   - Overage math if customer declines temporary quota increase: 1.4x committed unit price for tokens beyond committed baseline in the billing month (i.e., $1,260 / 1M tokens).

2) PAYG path:
   - No commitment; standard rate $1,200 / 1M tokens.
   - Soft-burst allowance: first 10 minutes of any spike are free of overage charges, but tokens count toward usage. Purpose is to avoid billing for short testing windows.
   - Overage beyond the month billed at 1.25x the standard rate for predictable spike events.

3) One-off concessions for pilot:
   - Apply a one-time $1,000 credit for migration/validation work.
   - Priority support for the pilot (direct Slack channel + 1 weekly check-in) — included.

If you agree, Rishi: I can add these as notes in the pricing PDF (pricing-estimate-avararetail-20260815.pdf) and we can prepare a short SOW (pilot-sow-draft.docx) for signature.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost alignment & spike policy options

Sam — appreciate the quick clarifications. Based on your spike profile and internal input, here are two concrete options (attached is an updated PDF and the pilot SOW draft):

Option A — Committed pilot (recommended for predictability)
- Commit: 8M tokens/month x 3 months
- Unit price: $900 / 1M tokens
- Soft-burst policy: allows transient bursts up to 3x baseline for 15 minutes without triggering an overage invoice (we still count the tokens).
- Sustained exceedance: if traffic remains > baseline for >24 hours, we will automatically provision a temporary quota increase and notify you; if you opt out, overage is billed at 1.4x unit price ($1,260 / 1M tokens).
- Pilot credit: $1,000 applied to first invoice.

Option B — PAYG (no commitment)
- Standard rate: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Short-burst grace: first 10 minutes of any spike are not charged as overage (tokens still count).
- Overage: billed at 1.25x standard rate beyond month quota.

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm which option you prefer (A or B) and a budget confirmation for the pilot.
2) Upload the 90-day sample (or confirm the attached CSV is representative).
3) I’ll send the SOW via DocuSign and we can schedule a 30-minute call Wednesday (I’m available 10:00–12:00 ET).

Links/attachments: pricing-estimate-avararetail-20260815.pdf, pilot-sow-draft.docx, HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If that looks ok I’ll send the SOW today and loop in Billing for a smooth first invoice.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
